text.body: <1> <1.1> śrotāraḥ pṛcchanti nanu ko'yaṃ granthaḥ?kim atra pratipāditam?asya śravaṇena kiṃ vā phalaṃ prāpyate ? 1.1.1 granthasya nāma dāsabodhaḥ|ayaṃ guruśiṣyasaṃvādaḥ|atra pratipāditaḥ viśadaḥ bhaktimārgaḥ|| 1.1.2 navavidhā bhaktiḥ tathā jñānam|uktaṃ vairāgyalakṣaṇam|bahudhā adhyātmanirūpaṇam|nirūpitam||1.1.3 bhaktyā manuṣyāḥ niścayena devaṃ prāpnuvanti iti abhiprāyaḥ asmin granthe vidyate|1.1.4 mukhyabhakteḥ niścayaḥ, śuddhajñānasya niścayaḥ, ātmasthiteḥ niścayaḥ atra pratipāditaḥ| 1.1.5 śuddhopadeśasya niścayaḥ, sāyojyamukteḥ niścayaḥ,mokṣaprāpteḥ ca niścayaḥ atra uktaḥ|| 1.1.6|| śuddhasvarūpasya niścayaḥ videhasthiteḥ niścayaḥ,aliptatvasya niścayaḥ atra uktaḥ || 1.1.7|| mukhyadevasya niścayaḥ, mukhyabhaktasya niścayaḥ,jīvaśivayoḥ niścayaḥ atra uktaḥ || 1.1.8|| mukhyabrahmaṇaḥ niścayaḥ, nānāmatānāṃ niścayaḥ,ko'ham iti niścayaḥ atra uktaḥ ||1.1.9|| mukhyam upāsanālakṣaṇaṃ, nānāvidhaṃ kavitvalakṣaṇaṃ,nānāvidhaṃ cāturyalakṣaṇam atra uktam || 1.1.10|| māyodbhavasya lakṣaṇaṃ, pañcabhūtānāṃ lakṣaṇāni, kartā kaḥ iti asya lakṣaṇam atra uktam || 1.1.11|| nānā vikalpāḥ nivāritāḥ| nānā saṃśayāḥ cheditāḥ|nānā āśaṃkāḥ uttaritāḥ, nānā praśnāḥ ca uttaritāḥ || 1.1.12|| evaṃ bahudhā nirūpitam |tathāpi graṃthagarbhe yad yad uktaṃ tat sarvam eva atra anūdituṃ na śakyate|| 1.1.13|| tathāpi samagraḥ dāsabodhaḥ daśakabhedena viśadīkṛtaḥ |tasya tasya daśakasya anuvādaḥ|tasmin tasmin daśake uktaḥ|| 1.1.14|| upaniṣadaḥ, vedāntaḥ śrutiḥ iti nānāgranthānāṃ sammatiḥ atra uktā|mukhyataḥ śāstrasahitā ātmapratītiḥ atra uktā|| 1.1.15|| nānā sammatīnām anvayaḥ asti ataḥ mithyā iti vaktuṃ na śakyate|tathāpi etat pratyakṣānubhavayogyam asti || 1.1.16|| matsareṇa etaṃ mithyā vadanti cet, sarve granthāḥ, nānā granthānāṃ sammatayaḥ,bhagavadvacanāni iti etat sarvam uccheditaṃ syāt|1.1.17|| śivagītā, rāmagītā, gurugītā, garbhagītā, uttaragītā, avadhūtagītā, vedaḥ tathā vedāntaḥ || 1.1.18|| bhagavadgītā, brahmagītā, haṃsagītā, pāṇḍavagītā, gaṇeśagītā, yemagītā, upaniṣadaḥ, bhāgavatam || 1.1.19|| ityādayaḥ nānā granthāḥ sammatyartham atra udāhṛtāḥ| yathārthaniścayārthaṃ bhagavadvākyāni udāhṛtāni ||1.1.20 bhagavadvacane yasya aviśvāsaḥ, etādṛśaḥ ko vā patitaḥ syāt?atra tu bhagavadvākyāvirahitaṃ vacanaṃ nāsti| nase || 1.1.21|| pūrṇagrantham anālocya eva yaḥ kevalaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ brūte, saḥ durātmā|matsareṇa saḥ durābhimānaṃ pradarśayati|1.1.22|| abhimānāt jāyate matsaraḥ|matsarāt jāyate tiraskāraḥ| agre krodhavikāraḥ anivāryatayā prabalaḥ bhavati|1.1.23|| aisā antaraṅge naṣṭaḥ| kāmakrodhābhyāṃ kṣubdhaḥ|ahaṃbhāvena parivartitaḥ iti sākṣāt dṛśyate|| 1.1.24|| yaḥ kāmakrodhābhyā avaliptaḥ saḥ sādhuḥ iti kathaṃ vācyaḥ?(kāmī) rāhuḥ amṛtasevanottaram api mṛtyuṃ prāptaḥ || 1.1.25|| astu idānīm etad bhāṣaṇam| adhikārānusāraṃ grāhyam|tathāpi abhimānaḥ tyājyaḥ iti uttamottamam || 1.1.26|| pūrvaṃ śrotṛbhiḥ pṛṣṭaṃ yad asmin granthe kiṃ pratipāditam? tasya uttaram etat saṅkalitarītyā nirūpitam 1.1.27|| atha śravaṇasya phalaṃ vadāmi|satvaraṃ kriyā parivartate, saṃśayasya mūlam akasmāt ucchidyate ||1.1.28|| sugamaḥ mārgaḥ prāpyate| na ca durgamasādhanasya apekṣā vidyate |sāyojyamukteḥ marma jñātaṃ bhavati|| 1.1.29|| naśyanti ajñānaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhrāntiḥ ca | bhavati śīghram eva atra jñānaprāptiḥ |evam asti phalaśrutiḥ| asmin granthe || 1.1.30|| yogināṃ yat paramaṃ bhāgyam iti ucyate,tad vairāgyaṃ siddhyati|yathāyogyaṃ cāturyaṃ savivekam avagamyate 1.1.31|| bhrāntāḥ durguṇāḥ avalakṣaṇāḥ janāḥ sulakṣaṇāḥ jāyante |dhūrtāḥ tārkikāḥ vicakṣaṇāḥ janāḥ samayajñāḥ jāyante || 1.1.32|| alasāḥ janāḥ udyoginaḥ bhavanti|pāpinaḥ paścāttāpam anubhavanti|nindakāḥ api vandante bhaktimārgam || 1.1.33|| baddhāḥ mumukṣavaḥ bhavanti|mūrkhāḥ atidakṣāḥ bhavanti |abhaktāḥ api bhaktimārgeṇa mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti | || 1.1.34|| nānā doṣāḥ naśyanti | patitāḥ pūtāḥ bhavanti |prāṇī śravaṇamātreṇa uttamāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuyāt | || 1.1.35|| dehabuddhijanyāni nānā saṅkaṭāni, saṃdehajanyāḥ nānā praśnāḥ,saṃsārajanyāḥ nānā udvegāḥ naśyanti śravaṇamātreṇa || 1.1.36|| evam asya phalaśrutiḥ yat śravaṇena adhogatiḥ nivāryate |manasaḥ viśramaḥ samādhānaṃ ca jāyeta |1.1.37|| yasya yathā bhāvaḥ tasya tathā lābhaḥ yaḥ puruṣaḥ matsaraṃ kuryād saḥ tameva prāpnuyāt|| 1.1.38|| iti śrīdāsabodhe guruśiṣyasaṃvāde granthārambhalakṣaṇaṃ nāma samāsaḥ prathamaḥ || 1|| <1.2> … <1.3> … <1.4> na jñāyate na jñāyate neti neti iti śrutiḥ api vadati|tatra mama mūrkhasya matiḥ kathamiva prabhavet?1.4.2 sadguruvarṇanasya vicāraṃ na jāne, ataḥ dūrādeva mama praṇāmaḥ|he guro paratīraṃ prāpaya mām|1.4.3 stavanasya durāśā āsīt|paraṃ māyāyāḥ ādhāraḥ naṣṭaḥ|idānīṃ he svāmin, he sadguro, yathā asi tādṛśaṃ tvāṃ namāmi|1.4.4 māyābalena staumi iti manovāñchā āsīt|tathāpi māyā lajjitā|kiṃ karavāṇi?1.4.5 na labhyate mukhyaḥ paramātmā|ataḥ tasya pratimā kriyate|evameva māyādhāreṇa sadguroḥ mahimānaṃ varṇayāmi|1.4.6 nijabhāvānusāraṃ devaḥ dhyāne smaryate|tathaiva (nijabhāvānusāram) ayaṃ sadguruḥ stotraiḥ stūyate|1.4.7 jaya jaya he sadgururāja, viśvambhara, viśvabīja, paramapuruṣa, mokṣadhana dīnabandho||1.4.8 tava abhayapradahastena durnivārā api iyaṃ māyā nivāryate|yathā sūryaprakāśena andhakāraḥ palāyate|1.4.9 ādityena andhakāraḥ nivāryate paraṃ punaḥ andhakāreṇa brahmāḍaṃ vyāpyate| niśāgame punarapi andhakāraḥ bhavati|1.4.10 tathā nāsti sadguruḥ|ayaṃ janmamṛtyū nivārayati|ajñānaṃ samūlaṃ mārjayati| 1.4.11 yathā suvarṇasya lohaṃ kadāpi na bhavati, tathā (niḥsandehaḥ) gurudāsaḥ kadāpi sandehaṃ na prāpnoti|1.4.12 yathā ca kācit sarit gaṅgāṃ prāptā|melane sati sā gaṅgā eva jātā| anantaraṃ yatnenāpi sā pṛthak na bhaviṣyati|1.4.13 tathāpi tasmāt melanāt pūrvaṃ tāṃ saritaṃ janāḥ ‘sāmānyā sarit' ityeva manyante|atra evaṃ nāsti|śiṣyaḥ (bodhalābhottaraṃ) svāmī eva jāyate|1.4.14 pāriṣamaṇiḥ (lohe) svatulyatāṃ na ādadhāti|suvarṇaṃ lohaṃ na parivartayati| tathā atra nāsti| sadguroḥ śiṣyaḥ bahubhyaḥ janebhyaḥ upadeśaṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ bhavati|1.4.15 (evaṃ) śiṣyaḥ gurutvaṃ prāpnoti|paraṃ suvarṇena (lohasya) suvarṇaṃ na bhavati| ataḥ sadguroḥ kṛte pāriṣopamānaṃ na śobhate|1.4.16 sāgarasya upamānaṃ cintayeyaṃ paraṃ saḥ atyantaṃ kṣāraḥ|ataḥ kṣīrasāgaraṃ cintayeyam|paraṃ saḥ kalpānte naśyati|1.4.17 meroḥ upamānaṃ vadeyaṃ paraṃ sa tu jaḍaḥ kaṭhoraḥ, pāṣāṇaḥ|nedṛśaḥ sadguruḥ bhavati| (eṣa tu) dīnaviṣaye komalaḥ|1.4.18 gaganasya upamānaṃ prayuñjeyaṃ paraṃ gaganādapi sadguruḥ nirguṇaḥ|ataḥ sadguroḥ kṛte gaganasya dṛṣṭāntaḥ hīnaḥ|1.4.19 dhairyārthaṃ pṛthivyāḥ upamānaṃ kathayeyaṃ paraṃ sāpi kalpānte naśyati|ataḥ dhairyārthaṃ vasundharāyāḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ nyūnaḥ|1.4.20 atha gabhastinā upaminomi cet gabhasteḥ prakāśaḥ kiyān?śāstrāṇi tasya maryādāṃ varṇayanti|sadgurustu amaryādaḥ|1.4.21 ataḥ upāmāyai dinakaraḥ nyūnaḥ|sadguruḥ jñānaprakāśaḥ mahān|atha śeṣasya upamānaṃ kalpayeya paraṃ saḥ api bhāravāhakaḥ|1.4.22 atha upamānārthaṃ jalaṃ vadeyaṃ paraṃ tadapi kālena śuṣyet|sadguroḥ svarūpaṃ niścalam|tad na śuṣyati|1.4.23 sadgurave amṛtasya upamānaṃ kalpayeya paraṃ (amṛtapāḥ) devāḥ api mṛtyupathaṃ gacchanti|sadgurukṛpā yathārtham amaratvaṃ dadāti|1.4.24 sadguruṃ kalpataruṃ sambodhayeyaṃ tathāpi ayaṃ sadguruḥ nāma kalpanātītaḥ vicāraḥ|tatra kalpavṛkṣasya aṅgīkāraṃ ko vā kuryāt?1.4.25 manasi cintāmātraṃ nāsti ataḥ cintāmaṇiṃ ko vā pṛcchati?kāmadhenoḥ dohanaṃ niṣkāmaḥ nāpekṣate|1.4.26 sadguruṃ lakṣmīvantaṃ bhāṣeya, paraṃ sā lakṣmī vināśaśīlā|sadguroḥ dvāre mokṣalakṣmī santiṣṭhate|1.4.27 svargalokaḥ, indrasya sampad iti etat kālena naśyati|sadgurukṛpayā yat prāpyate, tat kālenāpi na bhraśyati|1.4.28 hariḥ, haraḥ, brahmā ityādayaḥ sarve vināśaṃ gacchanti paraṃ sadgurupadam ekam avināśam|1.4.29 kiṃ tadartham upamānaṃ kalpayeya?(yato hi) sakalā sṛṣṭiḥ naśvarā|sadguroḥ upamānārthaṃ pāñcabhautikasya cintanaṃ vyartham|1.4.30 ataḥ sadguruḥ avarṇanīyaḥ iti etad eva etad eva mama varṇanam|antasthiteḥ cihnāni antarniṣṭhāḥ eva jānanti|1.4.31 iti caturthaḥ samāsaḥ| <1.5> atha vandeya sajjanān, ye khalu paramārthasya adhiṣṭhānabhūtāḥ|yannimittaṃ paramārthajñānaṃ jagati prakaṭaṃ bhavati|1.5.1 yad vastu paramadurlabhaṃ, yasya ca lābhaḥ atulanīyaḥ, tadvastu sādhusaṅgena sulabhaṃ bhavati|1.5.2 vastu prakaṭameva bhavati|tathāpi na ko'pi tat paśyati|nānā sādhanānām āyāsena api tad na prāpyate|||1.5.3 yatra parīkṣakāḥ bhrāntāḥ, athavā cakṣuṣmantaḥ api andhāḥ jātāḥ,nijavastu paśyantaḥ api draṣṭuṃ na śaktavantaḥ||1.5.4 yad dīpena api na dṛśyate, nānāvidhaiḥ prakāśaiḥ api na labhyate, netrāñjanena api dṛṣṭigocaraṃ na bhavati|||1.5.5 ṣoḍaśakalāyutaḥ pūrṇaḥ śaśī api vastu na prakāśayate|kalārāśiḥ tīvraḥ ādityaḥ api vastu na prakāśayate ||1.5.6 yena sūryaprakāśena ūrṇatantuḥ api dṛggocaraḥ bhavati, nānā aṇureṇavaḥ, sūkṣmapadārthāḥ bhāsamānāḥ bhavanti||1.5.7 chinnāgraḥ keśaḥ api yena prakāśyate,saḥ sūryaprakāśaḥ vastu na prakāśayate||1.5.8 yatra ākṣepāḥ kṣīṇāḥ yatra prayatnāḥ pariśrāntāḥ, yatra tarkāḥ nijavastunaḥ tarke mlānāḥ||1.5.9 yatra vivekasya balaṃ samāptaṃ,śabdasya vacanaṃ skhalitaṃ, yatra manasaḥ śīghratā niṣphalā jātā||1.5.10 vacananipuṇaḥ yaḥ sahasramukhaḥ śeṣaḥ, so'pi vastuvarṇane sarvathā śrāntaḥ, paraṃ vastu pūrṇataḥ na varṇitavān||1.5.11 vedena sarvamapi prakāśitam ?vedena anuktaṃ kimapi nāsti|saḥ vedaḥ api vastu na darśayate||1.5.12 tadeva vastu satasaṅgatyā svānubhavena jñāyate|tasyāḥ satsaṅgatyāḥ mahimānaṃ śabdena nirvaktuṃ ko vā samarthaḥ?1.5.13 asyāḥ māyāyāḥ śaktiḥ adbhutā, paraṃ sāpi vastucihnaṃ na darśayati|(tādṛśasya) anantasya prāptyupāyaṃ sādhavaḥ darśayanti|1.5.14 vastu avarṇanīyam|tadeva vastu sādhūnāṃ svarūpam|ataḥ sādhuvarṇanaṃ śabdasya kāryaṃ nāsti|1.5.15 sādhavaḥ ānandasya sthalam|sādhavaḥ sukhameva kevalam|nānāvidhasantoṣasya mūlaṃ sādhavaḥ eva|1.5.16 sādhavaḥ mokṣasya api viśrāntiḥ|tṛpteḥ api nijatṛptiḥ|athavā bhakteḥ api yā phalaśrutiḥ te ete sādhavaḥ|1.5.17 sādhavaḥ dharmasya dharmakṣetram|sādhavaḥ svarūpasya (svarūpabodhasya) satpātram|athavā sādhavaḥ puṇyasya api pūtā puṇyabhūmiḥ|1.5.18 sādhavaḥ samādhimandiram|sādhavaḥ vivekabhāṇḍāgāram|athavā sādhavaḥ sāyujyamukteḥ mātṛgṛham iti vaktavyam|1.5.19 sādhavaḥ satyasya viniścayaḥ|sādhavaḥ sāphalyasya vijayaḥ|sādhavaḥ prāpteḥ siddhaḥ samayaḥ|1.5.20 mokṣaśriyā alaṅkṛtāḥ ime sādhavaḥ, yaiḥ agaṇitāḥ daridrāḥ jīvāḥ nṛpatipadaṃ prāpitāḥ|1.5.21 ye samarthāḥ ca udārāḥ ca , ye atyantaṃ dānaśūrāḥ, te api etaṃ jñānavicāraṃ dātuṃ na samarthāḥ|1.5.22 cakravartinaḥ mahārājāḥ bhūtāḥ bhavanti bhaviṣyanti ca|paraṃ sāyujyamuktiṃ na ko'pi dadāti|1.5.23 trilokyām api yad dānaṃ nāsti, tat sajjanāḥ kurvanti|teṣāṃ sādhūnāṃ mahimānaṃ katham iva varṇanīyam?||1.5.24 yat trailokyād vilakṣaṇaṃ, yacca śruterapi agamyaṃ tadeva parabrahma yeṣāṃ kṛpayā antaḥkaraṇe prakaṭaṃ bhavati (te ime sādhavaḥ)||1.5.25 īdṛśo'sti sādhumahimā|sarvā upamā atra nyūnāyate|eteṣāṃ kṛpayā mukhyaḥ paramātmā prakaṭaḥ bhavati||1.5.26 iti śrīdāsabodhe guruśiṣyasaṃvāde samāsaḥ pañcamaḥ || 5|| <1.6> atha vande śrotṛjanān|ye bhaktāḥ, jñāninaḥ, sādhavavvḥ, sajjanāḥ,viraktāḥ, yoginaḥ, guṇasampannāḥ satyavādinaḥ (tān śrotṛjanān vande)| ||1.6.1 eke sattvasāgarāḥ, eke buddheḥ ādhārabhūtāḥ, eke śrotāraḥ, nānā śabdaratnānāṃ khanibhūtāḥ (tān śrotṛjanān vande)||1.6.2 ye nānā arthāmṛtasya bhoktāraḥ, prasaṅge vaktuḥ api vaktāraḥ, nānā saṃśayacchedakāḥ, niścayinaḥ puruṣāḥ, (tān śrotṛjanān vande)||1.6.3 yeṣāṃ dhāraṇāśaktiḥ apārā,ye īśvarasya avatārāḥ, athavā sākṣāt suravarāḥ,eva upaviṣṭāḥ, (tān śrotṛjanān vande)||1.6.4 athavā ye sattvasthānāṃ śāntānām ṛṣivarāṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ, yena sabhāmaṇḍalam atīva śobhitaṃ, (tān śrotṛjanān vande)||1.6.5 yeṣāṃ hṛdaye vedasāraḥ vilasati, mukhe sarasvatī vilasati, ye sāhityaṃ yadā vadanti tadā bṛhaspatitulyā bhāsante,(tān śrotṛjanān vande) ||1.6.6 ye pāvitryeṇa vaiśvānarāḥ,ye sphūrtikiraṇānāṃ dinakarāḥ,jñātṛtvena brahmāṇḍād api vistṛtāḥ, (tān śrotṛjanān vande)||1.6.7 ye sadā sāvadhānāḥ,ye trikālajñāḥ,sarvadā nirabhimānāḥ, ātmajñāḥ,(tān śrotṛjanān vande)||1.6.8 yaiḥ adṛṣṭaṃ kimapi nāvaśiṣṭam|yaiḥ manasā sakalapadārthāḥ lakṣitāḥ(tān śrotṛjanān vande) ||1.6.9 yat kimapi vadāmaḥ tad eteṣāṃ jñātapūrvaṃ vidyate|tatra jñātṛtvābhiniveśena kimiti anuvadanīyama?||1.6.10 paramete guṇagrāhakāḥ ataḥ niḥśaṅkaṃ vadāmi|bhāgyavantaḥ puruṣāḥ kimiti na sevante?||1.6.11 bhāgyavantaḥ puruṣāḥ sadā divyānnāni sevante tathāpi parivartanāya sāmānyam annam api sevante|tathaiva mama prākṛtāni (sāmānyāni) vacanāni api (seviṣyante)||1.6.12 svaśaktim anusṛtya bhāvena devaḥ pūjanīyaḥ|(sāmagryabhāvaḥ astīti)devaḥ naiva pūjanīyaḥ iti vicāraḥ kvāpi nāsti||1.6.13 tathaivāhaṃ kaścid vāgdurbalaḥ|śrotāraḥ sākṣāt parameśvararūpāḥ|vācālo'haṃ teṣāṃ pūjanāya pravṛttaḥ||1.6.14 na me vyutpattiḥ, na kalā, na cāturyaṃ na prabandhakauśalaṃ, na bhaktiḥ, na jñānaṃ, na vairāgyaṃ, na vā mādhuryam||1.6.15 īdṛśo mama vāgvilāsaḥ|tathāpi jagadīśaḥ bhāvam apekṣate, ityataḥ niḥśaṅkatayā sāvakāśaṃ vadāmi||1.6.16 śrotāraḥ yūyaṃ bhagavanmūrtirūpāḥ|tatra mama vyutpattiḥ kīdṛśī?buddhihīnaḥ alpamatiḥ ahaṃ tathāpi (yuṣmābhiḥ saha) sakhyabhāvena varte||1.6.17 samarthaputraḥ mūrkho'pi (pituḥ) sāmarthyaṃ labhate|ataḥ
